verdict.rationale: Honcho's docs say users store raw messages and Honcho reasons over them in the background to build peer representations (gh-1). A dedicated 'deriver' process runs alongside the API (docs-10), and answers come from a reasoned representation rather than raw retrieval (docs-11, docs-1). The Dreamer working-memory feature hints at consolidation but is opt-in and off by default (docs-23). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how salient facts are selected and extracted, detail on how background consolidation works (Dreamer is opt-in and thinly described), and independent or hands-on corroboration of recall quality.
